info.description: Attachment METADATA for an imported message. M2 deliberately stores no binary — the live gateway can still fetch the part from the mailbox while it exists; binary snapshots via the upload provider are the recorded M3+ upgrade (docs/todo/email-program/01-data-model.md).

cid.description: Inline content-id, when the part is referenced from the HTML body.

part_id.description: Index into the parsed attachment list at import time — the live getAttachment key.
